protocol.question: Does an environmental change alter the benefit of faithful inherited memory?
protocol.primary: Difference in memory benefit: (faithful − none) after change minus (faithful − none) in a stable world.
protocol.prediction: The memory benefit is smaller after environmental change (primary contrast < 0).
protocol.outcome: Mean occupied fraction during ticks 120–239, including zeros after extinction.
protocol.unit: Independent world seed; treatments are paired within seeds.
protocol.controls: Same starting world, controller, founders, resource rules, horizon and exogenous random field. Mutation disabled.
caveats: Simulation only; no LLMs are tested.
Shuffling permutes action labels in parental memory; it does not sample unrelated lineages.
Confidence intervals quantify variation across seeds within this model, not real-world validity.
The environment change is total and abrupt. Other kinds of change may behave differently.
Only the primary contrast is confirmatory. All secondary contrasts are descriptive.
protocol.note: Protocol recorded before this campaign. Pilot calibration is documented separately.

assessment.text: Both seed blocks support the prespecified negative interaction. External validity is untested.

rawArchive: research/runs/*.json.gz and research/ledger.sqlite on the originating computer
reproducibility: Exact replay: configuration + source hash. Full action traces retained locally.
provenance: Measured execution of the baseline simulator; no LLM inference.
